nurse.text: Afternoon. Station Medical Centre, which the sign outside calls a Sanctuary because a Wing Commander lost an argument.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Pop your team on the trolley. We treat everything that comes through the door, from sprained wings to altitude sickness.
All patched up and fit to fly. You've got a clean bill of health from the RAF.
The Ark's behind the counter. Please do not feed it.

else.text: Take your time. The kettle's always on. It's the station's one constant.
